thread.title: Canadian Media Struggle to Digest PM Carney's Chummy Meeting with Trump
thread.title_full: Canadian Media Struggle to Digest PM Carney's Chummy Meeting with Trump

author: Lepantzeus
text:
Trump is telling the EU to stop spending $275 billion a year buying oil and gas from Russia, and to instead by oil and gas from Canada and the U.S.
Biden killed the KEYSTONE PIPELINE, which would have been the single largest source of export revenue for Canada. Trump supports the KEYSTONE PIPELINE. It is 2/3 finished. It could be completed in less than 2 years.
Trump has brought down both interest rates and inflation in the United States which will benefit Canada.
They ought to be chummy. ;-)
ps: The Canadians still need to secure their side of the border, shut down the drug labs flooding illegal drugs into the U.S. - one way to do that is better management of chemicals coming in from China - those drugs have killed hundreds of thousands of Americans from overdoses, and Canada still isn't meeting the 2% of GDP for Defense target all NATO countries agreed upon ten years ago.
Americans have legitimate complaints with Canada, even if Canadians want to get their 'feelz' hurt about it. ;-)
